title: Skin Allergies, Rash & Eczema (Kushta / Udarda) — Dual-System Monograph
source: CDSCO / British Association of Dermatologists / AYUSH API
content:
Condition: Skin Allergy, Urticaria (Hives), Itching & Eczema (Vicharchika / Udarda).
Allopathic Pharmacology: Cetirizine 10mg or Fexofenadine 120-180mg once daily (antihistamines). Calamine lotion topical soothing agent. Hydrocortisone 1% cream (short-term for localized allergic eczema under medical advice).
Ayurvedic Formulations: Neem Ghanavati (500mg twice daily - blood purifier and antimicrobial). Khadirarishta (15ml with equal water after meals). Mahatiktaka Ghrita or Gandhaka Rasayana.
Home Remedies: Neem leaf boiled water for bathing/washing affected skin, Virgin Coconut oil application, Aloe Vera fresh gel application, Oatmeal lukewarm bath soak.
Precautions: Do not scratch to avoid secondary bacterial infections. Avoid hot water baths and harsh chemical soaps.
